content_html:
Website Development Cost in Patna: Business Website Pricing Guide

Website development cost in Patna usually falls between ₹10,000 and ₹40,000 for a basic business website, ₹40,000 to ₹1.5 lakh for a larger site with more pages and SEO, and from about ₹60,000 upwards for ecommerce or custom features. Maintenance adds roughly ₹1,000 to ₹5,000 a month for a small site. The final price depends on pages, design, content, features and support, so always compare itemised quotes rather than headline prices.

Website development cost in Patna by site type

Website typeTypical costGood for
Single-page or starter site₹5,000 – ₹15,000New shops, freelancers
Basic business website (5–10 pages)₹10,000 – ₹40,000Clinics, coaching, local services
Larger business site with blog and SEO₹40,000 – ₹1.5 lakhSchools, builders, growing firms
Ecommerce store₹60,000 – ₹3 lakhRetailers selling online
Custom portal or web app₹1.5 lakh upwardsAdmissions, bookings, dashboards

These are rough ranges, not fixed prices.

What drives the price

  • Number of pages and how much content is needed.
  • Design: a customised template is cheaper than a fully original design.
  • Content: writing, photography and translation into Hindi add cost.
  • Features: payment gateways, booking, admission forms, multi-language.
  • Platform: WordPress is usually cheapest; custom code costs more.
  • SEO and speed work beyond the basics.
  • Support: training, maintenance and response times.

Recurring costs to budget for

ItemTypical cost
Domain name (.com or .in)A few hundred to about ₹1,500 a year
HostingAbout ₹2,000 – ₹15,000 a year for small sites
Maintenance₹1,000 – ₹5,000 a month for a small site
Premium plugins or appsVaries

Our website hosting vs maintenance guide explains the difference.

How to reduce the cost

  1. Start with the pages you truly need, then grow.
  2. Prepare your own text, photos and logo.
  3. Use a proven CMS such as WordPress instead of custom code.
  4. Add advanced features in a second phase.
  5. Choose a yearly maintenance plan rather than paying for emergencies.

Common pricing mistakes

First, choosing the cheapest quote without checking what is included. Next, forgetting yearly renewals. Then, paying everything upfront. Finally, skipping maintenance, which often costs more later when the site is hacked or breaks. If you are taking online payments, check your gateway's fees too; the Reserve Bank of India sets rules for payment aggregators.

Sample budget for a Patna clinic website

For example, a clinic in Patna might need a home page, about page, doctor profiles, services, appointment request form, contact page and a simple blog. In addition, it would want WhatsApp and call buttons, Google Maps and basic local SEO. Such a site usually sits in the basic-to-mid business range, plus domain, hosting and a small monthly maintenance fee. As a result, the first-year business website cost in Patna is the build price plus renewals and upkeep, so budget for both from the start.

Frequently asked questions

How much does website development cost in Patna?

A basic business website often costs ₹10,000 to ₹40,000, a larger business site ₹40,000 to ₹1.5 lakh and an ecommerce or custom site from about ₹60,000 upwards.

What affects website cost in Patna?

Number of pages, design work, content writing, ecommerce or booking features, integrations such as payment gateways, and the level of SEO and support.

How much does maintenance cost?

Basic maintenance often costs ₹1,000 to ₹5,000 a month for a small site. Stores and busy sites need more.

How can I reduce the cost?

Start with the pages you really need, prepare your own text and photos, use a proven platform such as WordPress and add features in phases.
